provenance.note: The stated minimum 3.0 GPA is kept as an unfiled quote because the schema has no field for a grade bar. Sponsorship is silent: the page contains no occurrence of citizen, visa, CPT, OPT, sponsor or work authorisation. That silence is worth noting rather than assuming, because the Federal Reserve Board states a flat citizenship bar and the Atlanta Fed states a CPT position, while this body publishes neither. Silent here means only that nothing is published on the point.
